facts.fact: Liquid Intelligent Technologies CEO Deon Geyser told ITWeb that under the Eastern Cape Fibre Project with SITA and the provincial government, all almost 2,700 contracted government properties in the least-connected province are connected, 2,000 by fibre and 700 by interim 4G and 5G.

systems.owner: SITA, Liquid and Eastern Cape Provincial Government

systems.system: Liquid Eastern Cape fibre network (7,000 km)

ZAF.note: The fibre being built is one province's network, with no link between the capital and other regions stated.
SITA is named only as a partner in a contract run by Liquid; no systems run by government staff are stated.
